degree_plan_passages.text:
Systems, Cloud and Security track. Students interested in operating systems, networks, cloud, distributed systems, parallel computing and cybersecurity follow the Systems track. Typical sequence: CS203 Computer Organization in Year 2, then CS302 Operating Systems, CS320 Computer Networks, SEC301 Information Security Fundamentals and CS370 Parallel and GPU Computing in Year 3, and CS401 Cloud Computing and Distributed Systems in Year 4.

## Advising notes

Capstone. Senior Project I (CS410) is offered in Fall only and Senior Project II (CS411) in Spring only. Students should plan the capstone for their final two semesters after finishing Software Engineering (CS310).

evidence.policy_text: Every prerequisite listed for a course must have been completed with a grade of C or higher.
